capabilities_done: (1) model: pulse keeps no parallel marker/transition set; RecordEdit{AddMarker{scope}, ReplaceMarker, RemoveMarker, SetTransition{outgoing clip, Option<TimelineTransition>}, SetWorkArea} edits Folio's StudioMarker / TimelineTransition / WorkArea as one undoable proposal (plan_record_edit -> propose -> plan_timeline_revert); clip splits hand markers to the piece holding their start and the tail transition to the right piece (split_records in split_clip and write_pieces); every edit removes transitions that no longer play and lists them (EditProposal::dropped_transitions) and lists markers that left (removed_markers)

folio: StudioSequence.work_area (STU-VID-035), TimelineTransition.parameters [{param_key, param_value number|boolean|enumeration|ticks}] (STU-FX-103 keys, unique, <= 256, finite) and repeat_end_frame (STU-VID-032), all serde-default and omitted when unset (byte-identical old documents); param_value is not named 'value' because Folio's read-only extension check treats any object with key 'value' as a length

(2) PR-19 PlaybackScheduler: AudioClock port (sample rate + played samples), HeadlessClock, master ticks = anchor + ticks_from_samples (exact for rates dividing 254016000000); DropLate presents floor(master / tpf) and counts skipped frames (end-of-range skips included); PresentEveryFrame never skips and reports lag; play range = work area or whole sequence; pause/scrub/step frame-exact and clamped; frame_layers(tick) = enabled video tracks bottom-to-top with transition weights

stated tolerance (test playback_stays_within_one_frame_of_the_audio_clock): with DropLate at every presentation 0 <= master - frame_start < one frame period (40 ms at 25 fps); irregular presenter cadence of 1..4000 samples: presented + dropped = 100 of 100 frames, leads 0

(2) audio path: pulse src/audio.rs build_timeline_mix: Folio audio tracks (enabled, unmuted, solo honoured; track volume linear -> score dB fader, pan) -> score Session; clips by TrackSpec::from_source / from_source_at_speed; audio_crossfade tail -> score Fade pair over the transition span using the outgoing tail handle and incoming head handle (curve param linear|equal_power, default equal_power, Studio key); > score MAX_TRACKS clips = limit_exceeded before copying; score Session implements AudioClock; folio StudioTrack.volume (default 1.0, 0..=16) and pan (-1..=1) per STU-FX-137, serde-default; test timeline_audio_mixes_through_score_and_clocks_video_within_one_frame (mixdown within 1e-6 of hand values through the crossfade; every presentation within [0, 1 frame) of the score position)

(3) program monitor: harness src/view/monitor.rs ProgramMonitor (play/pause/scrub/step, refresh renders frame_layers through composite render_scene on render-cpu; FrameSource port; WallClock for the viewer; stable widget ids monitor.*) + Viewer::open_monitor / set_monitor_sources / monitor() and a bottom panel; tests viewer_monitor.rs (2): dissolve frames vs hand blend within 2e-6, pause/step/scrub/end, typed frame_unavailable; viewer opens the monitor on a native package sequence and draws its ids
